cover: Gulf shipping comes under fire as political unrest grips major capitals worldwide
cover_scene: A commercial tanker navigates a dark, misty maritime strait under dramatic storm clouds as distant coastal flares burn along the horizon.

slides.scene: A massive liquefied natural gas carrier transits the Persian Gulf under heavy grey skies, shadowed by military patrol vessels.
slides.headline: Persian Gulf Tanker Struck by Unidentified Projectiles
slides.body: The Qatari liquefied natural gas carrier Al Mayeda sustained material damage after being struck by unidentified objects in the Persian Gulf. The strike highlights escalating threats to vital energy shipping lanes as regional tensions continue to mount.

slides.scene: A dense Parisian boulevard packed with demonstrators under autumn trees as French flags flutter and riot police hold defensive lines.
slides.headline: Mass Protests Against Rising Living Costs Shake Europe
slides.body: Demonstrators filled streets across France and Germany to voice opposition against surging living expenses and government policies, leading to clashes with police. Authorities in major cities deployed security forces to curb unauthorized marches and widespread property destruction.

slides.scene: A row of illuminated American voting booths inside a quiet hall, draped with American state banners ahead of election day.
slides.headline: Candidates Mount Final Push Ahead of Critical Midterms
slides.body: Political campaigns intensified nationwide get-out-the-vote efforts across critical battleground states during the final weekend before the 2026 midterm elections. Candidates focused heavily on undecided voters and early turnout margins amid contentious intra-party splits and high-stakes legal battles.

slides.scene: Plumes of dense black smoke rising from burning industrial storage tanks at an oil refinery at night, illuminated by orange fire.
slides.headline: Ukrainian Drones Strike Major Russian Oil Refinery
slides.body: Ukrainian drones successfully struck an oil refinery in Kstovo within Russia's Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, sparking a major fire at the industrial facility. The attack comes as Ukraine's General Staff reported record-high Russian monthly casualties during intense front-line combat.

slides.scene: A packed floodlit English football stadium at night with players in red and yellow jerseys battling near the goal under rain.
slides.headline: Arsenal Go Top with Win at Liverpool
slides.body: Arsenal secured their first victory at Anfield since 2012, beating Liverpool to claim the top spot in the Premier League. The narrow away victory moves them three points clear of title rivals Manchester City.
